scores.scale: 1-5 higher is better; engineering judgement, not measurement

parallelWork: Model-integrity route-quality probes continue alongside new candidate work; no identity certification and no freeze until monitoring is fully implemented.
humanGate: Review three proposed implementations, file scope, extension hooks, durable events, configuration and real E2E before coding.

prerequisite: Persist the applicable original human instructions independently of model-authored Goal objectives; retain initial and appended requirements across create/edit/reopen. Presentation caps do not revoke constraints.

candidateSharedSemantics.humanInstructionSource: Human messageId + taskScopeId + original text in Session; derived applicability, explicit supersession/revocation and instruction revision are persisted. Model goal creation/edit is not revocation.
candidateSharedSemantics.coverage: All actual tool calls first use local explicit capability/path/allowlist/denylist checks, including read-only and delegation. Jev only handles relevant unresolved intent.
candidateSharedSemantics.initialParsing: Related tool execution waits once for a bounded current-input parse. Cancel or instruction-version changes invalidate pending judgements.
candidateSharedSemantics.limits: Display and prompt caps never silently discard effective prohibitions; incomplete coverage is visible, while explicit deterministic prohibitions remain enforced.
candidateSharedSemantics.continuationAndRecovery: Neither can bypass a denied tool, required approval, user stop or valid instructions. State-version keyed semantic reuse and shared per-request budgets prevent repeated judge calls.

reviewFindings.evidence: completion-browser-session.jsonl seq6 preserves full human instruction; seq18 native create_goal replaces goal text and clears items. Clean browser case follows allowed tools; an earlier isolated fixture run used glob outside the five-tool restriction and later completed. Not counted as accepted browser run.
reviewFindings.next: Implement instruction-source retention as a prerequisite of the proposed constraint P0; add forbidden read-only tool E2E.

publicCopyRule: All slogans are proposals; published claims must state supported execution scope and measured scenarios. Unknown judge answers and bounded completion refusals are not absolute enforcement.
